name: Chinkamo Twins 2! ~Natsu da! Umi da! Futago no Imouto Oppai Taiketsu da!~
original_name: ちんかもツインズ２！ ～夏だ！海だ！ふたごの妹おっぱい対決だ！～
source:
After the last time they were in danger of staying in school, the siblings are now safely together.
They live in harmony, sometimes checking each other out.

One day, they decide to take a trip to the beach with a lottery ticket they received when they went shopping. The three sisters are excited about the trip and have a lot of fun.

Sea→Swimsuit→Skin color!　

We can have fun and seduce our brother!
How much more can the older brother put up with such thoughts from the younger sisters?

[Translated from [url=http://milimili.amusecraft.com/chinkamo2/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
在上次面临留在学校的危险之后，兄弟姐妹现在安全地在一起了。
他们生活得很和谐，有时还会互相检查。

有一天，他们决定带着一张购物时收到的彩票去海滩旅行。三姐妹对这次旅行很兴奋，玩得很开心。

海→泳装→肤色！　

我们可以开心地勾引我们的兄弟！
哥哥更能忍受妹妹们的这种想法吗？

[翻译自[url=http://milimili.amusecraft.com/chinkamo2/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
